name: Magic in Your Blood
source:
In a world where magic has become reality, you play as a student in an academy that opens its door to all who wish to learn better about how to be a magician. Your day are mostly peaceful, studying in the campus during the day, and doing part-time in the  evening... But then, you stumble across an odd rumor linking the recent assault case at the town, with that of the old myth of vampires... and also with that young and popular Energy Magic teacher, for some reason? It all sounds very silly--until you accidentally see your teacher out in the forest one night.

Getting bored of your routine, you might as well try to look into it a bit... it's not like anything bad going to happen to you, right?

[From [url=https://sbhunter.itch.io/magic-in-your-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在魔法已成为现实的世界中，你扮演一所学院的学生，该学院向所有希望更好地学习如何成为魔术师的人敞开大门。你的日子大多是平静的，白天在校园里学习，晚上做兼职……但随后，你偶然发现了一个奇怪的谣言，将最近发生在小镇的袭击事件与吸血鬼的古老神话联系起来……并且还与那位年轻而受欢迎的能量魔法老师联系在一起，出于某种原因？这一切听起来都很愚蠢——直到有一天晚上你偶然在森林里看到了你的老师。

厌倦了你的日常生活，你不妨尝试一下看看……这不像是有什么不好的事情会发生在你身上，对吧？

[来自[url=https://sbhunter.itch.io/magic-in-your-blood]Itch.io[/url]]
